shared_elements: script or writing signs integrated with figural imagery
low-relief carved figural scene on a rectangular framed panel
justification: Both depict profile human figures in low relief with raised arms alongside dense non-alphabetic script signs, and both include stylised plant/floral forms, but these are generic correspondences. A shows a small lunette scene of multiple worshipping figures beneath a rayed disc above many horizontal ruled lines of text, whereas B is dominated by a single large winged figure with horned/tiered headdress tending a stylised plant, with no text register and completely different proportions and rendering conventions (feather-by-feather wing, patterned beard) from A's small schematic figures.
